components.name: sidebar-wrapper
components.title: Sidebar Wrapper
components.description: A full sidebar wrapper layout.
message: Wrap your sidebar markup with <x-ui.sidebar-wrapper> to get open/close toggle behaviour.
Import resources/js/sidebar-plugin.js in your Vite entry point (e.g. app.js) to activate the sidebar plugin.
Add data-toggle-sidebar to any button that should open/close the sidebar on mobile.

components.name: sidebar01
components.title: Sidebar 01
components.description: A full sidebar layout.
message: Include <x-layouts.sidebar> at the top level of your page — it renders as a fixed left panel.
Use <x-atoms.sidebar-item> inside the sidebar nav for each link (accepts href, icon, text, isActive).
Place <x-layouts.wrapper> after the sidebar; it offsets by md:pl-64 and holds your header + content.
Add data-toggle-sidebar to your mobile menu button inside <x-layouts.wrapper> to open the sidebar.

components.name: sidebar02
components.title: Sidebar 02
components.description: A full sidebar layout with grouped navigation.
message: Include <x-layouts.sidebar> at the top level of your page — it renders as a fixed left panel.
Use <x-atoms.sidebar-nav-group> inside the sidebar to group nav links under a labelled section.
Use <x-atoms.sidebar-item> inside each nav group (accepts href, icon, text, isActive).
Place <x-layouts.wrapper> after the sidebar; it offsets by lg:pl-64 and holds your header + content.
Add data-toggle-sidebar to your mobile menu button inside <x-layouts.wrapper> to open the sidebar.

components.name: shell01
components.title: App Shell 01
components.description: Application shell layout.
message: Use <x-layouts.app-shell> as your root layout — it composes the sidebar and main content area.
The shell embeds <x-layouts.sidebar02> automatically; customise that file to change the sidebar.
Use <x-atoms.sidebar-item> for each nav link inside the sidebar (accepts href, icon, text, isActive).
Use <x-atoms.sidebar-nav-group> to group sidebar links under a labelled section heading.
Place <x-layouts.wrapper> inside the shell for the header + scrollable content region.
Add data-toggle-sidebar to your mobile menu button inside <x-layouts.wrapper> to open the sidebar.
